newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks power to new highs at close.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks power to new highs at close.

text.p: Madrid stock indices gained again on Monday to reach new closing highs bolstered by buyers in Telefonica, Repsol, Endesa and some of the big banks.
Optimism ahead of first quarter results and good news for key companies was the driving force behind today's gain, as well as a rosy macro-economic backdrop, dealers said.
The general index up 3.20 points, 0.65 pct, to 494.36 and the Ibex-35 added 42.80 points, 0.76 pct, to 5,670.94.
Telefonica added 50 pesetas to 3,645 after last week's deal with MCI/BT got a positive reception from investors.
Repsol surged at the end of period for provisional retail share orders, rising 70 pesetas to 6,370. The maximum offer price will be set later today.
BCH bank was also at highs, adding 30 pesetas ot 4,150 with some analysts forecasting a 25 percent increase in quarterly earnings, due to be announced later this week.

Endesa was also up sharply adding 150 pesetas to 9,600 after news it is to bid in a consortium for second telephone operator. The firm announced aggressive cost cutting at an analyst meeting on Friday, received well by investors, dealers said.
The market may well see a correction tomorrow after recent gains, they added.
